title: Restores three files the orders release overwrote: the Alarms list's plain names and its drawer's fix first, the drawer title on two lines, two FAQ entries
why: #269 (Jobs and words, Jason approved) and #270 (Orders release A) went live a minute apart. #270 was built before #269 and carried app/admin/kit-css.php, app/admin/tools.php and app/ui/faq.md, so after Sync 18:40 UTC those three match #270 and #269's changes to them are gone from the live site. This release starts from the live copies (Sync 18:40 UTC, a71303b) and re-applies only #269's changes to them: the Alarms list names a part plainly (never job:identity_re…), an alarm's drawer leads with its fix (Open its job / Open its card) and gives its times in one labelled UTC format, a drawer's title wraps to two lines instead of being cut, and the FAQ's Sync chip line and 'Which account does each outside service sign in as?'. Every line of #270 is kept. Nothing else changes.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
